title: Arweave Puzzle #11

prize.note: 1 ETH, address held as a plain EOA, never spent from since funding

target_format: raw 32-byte / 64-hex secp256k1 private key, standard ETH address derivation, no mnemonic, no keystore

derivation.summary: extract a 256-bit value from the pixel content of the published PNG (channel, order, and quantization not yet determined) and compare its ETH address to the escrow address
derivation.certified_against: the derivation primitives (SHA-256, Keccak-256, secp256k1, EIP-55) are checked against public test vectors, but no known-answer image-to-key pair exists for this specific puzzle, so no oracle is shipped

difficulty_note: the target format (raw private key, not a mnemonic) and the decoy (the address printed in the file's tEXt chunk) are both confirmed; close to 1,000 direct encodings of the measured geometry and the metadata anomaly have been tested, all negative; the exact pixel-level encoding is not yet known and no certified oracle exists to test one against, so the missing piece is either an unrecovered insight into the encoding or the never-delivered author hint

leads.title: systematic LSB scan of the continuous grayscale and alpha channels
join the community Telegram group and search first-hand for the promised hint

third_party_material: the puzzle image in clues/ is the author's own published puzzle material, stored on Arweave; the author's quotes in clues/author-posts.md are reproduced from a community repository that itself mirrors the author's Twitter replies; no other third-party material is included
